notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Money operations take idempotency_key and check audit first: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: if ledgerly.audit.events() has an entry with that key, return the original result without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the audit.record entry.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money results with round_money: Any monetary value computed in ledgerly must be passed through round_money from ledgerly.money before being returned; use to_money to coerce inputs and ZERO as the sum seed.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 2 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0002] Annotate money functions returning Decimal: Functions in ledgerly/invoice.py that return monetary amounts should be annotated `-> Decimal` (imported from decimal), matching line_total and invoice_total.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 2 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable codes: Reject invalid billing operations by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount" rather than ValueError or bare exceptions.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming or stored datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic, rather than assuming tz-awareness.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0008] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when the amount exceeds the threshold and approved_by is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

texts.at-0004: Exclude bool when validating integers When validating integer fields such as quantity, check isinstance(x, bool) first because bool is a subclass of int; otherwise True would pass a positive-integer check.

item.title: Record audit events for state changes
item.content: Every payment state transition must call `audit.record(...)` with an event name like `payment_captured` and the payment id and amount, so the audit log stays the source of truth.
